Church of the Society of Jesus

A Jesuit façade facing the main square

Current ratingsOpening hoursView the place on the map
Nearby places

Explore

The Jesuit church shares the main square with the cathedral but has a distinct carved façade between two towers. Step towards the centre of the plaza to see the entire composition before inspecting the stone carving at close range.

Planning your visit

30–45 min · Allow this time for the visit itself. Add travel, admission queues and any scheduled tour separately.

What to look for

A Jesuit façade facing the main square

Choose a point where the carved central portal stands clear of the two towers. The lower portions can be studied later from the pavement without stopping on the steps.

Getting there

History and local experience

The stone carving concentrates at the central entrance. Look from the edge inward to see the transition from the broad mass of the towers to the fine shadow around the portal.

Walking route

  1. Plaza de Armas, Iglesia de la Compañía de Jesús, Cusco
  2. Walk from the fountain toward the Jesuit façade, pause below the portal and enter only during visitor access.
  3. A side angle from the plaza shows the depth of the carvings without blocking the church steps.
